tests.description: Two-step sequence: constant medium then sine medium, same direction.
Sine starts, triangle joins after 1s and overlaps for 2s.
Constant and sine start together in orthogonal directions.
Spring and damper conditions running simultaneously.
Four constants played one after another in 0/90/180/270 degrees.
Ramp up then hold with constant effect.
Two sines with different phases, back to back.
Inertia and friction condition effects running together.
